column1: # Every sample the matrix runs a tool on. Paths may use ${CAT} (lab data collection), ${EUK} (Vir's plant/human work
# dir), ${UMBC} (SPO1 share), ${ME} (scratch). gtdir = where a row's relative gt/cand files live. nreads = first N
# alignments of the coordinate-sorted BAM (0 = every read). reuse = a folder under ${EUK} whose sub.bam / UniMeth 5mC /
# DeepMod2 outputs are linked instead of recomputed (the plant/human rows already ran there). A BAM without move
# tables (mv tags) is re-basecalled from the pod5 with --emit-moves by MODE=basecall (prep submits it when needed).
# region_from (optional 8th column): take this sample's subset from the region spanned by that sample's sub.bam instead of
# its first NREADS alignments, so a two-sample row's control covers the same positions as its modified sample.
# hg002: the collection's ont_open_data folder is ~1x; the row uses the first 500 pod5_pass files of the public GIAB
# flowcell (~11x, download_hg002.sh) basecalled with move tables by basecall_moves.sh, same GRCh38 ground truth.
